senses.gloss: शं—कर॑ See below.
शंकर॑ mf(ई)n. causing prosperity, auspicious, beneficent, Nir.; MBh.; BhP.
शंकर॑ m. N. of Rudra or Śiva, VS.; ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.
of a son of Kaśyapa and Danu, VP.
of Skanda, AV.Pariś.
of a serpent-demon, L.
of a Cakra-vartin, L.
N. of various authors and commentators, (esp.) of Śaṃkarācārya (see next page, col. 1; also with भट्ट, पण्डित, शर्मन्, राजानक, &c.)
शंकरा (आ), f. (cf. शं-गरा under शं above) = शकुनिका, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 14, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
N. of a female, ib.
a partic. Rāga or musical mode, MW.
शांकर mf(ई)n. (fr. शं-कर) relating or belonging to Śiva, Kathās.
relating to or derived from or composed by Śaṃkarācārya, Sarvad.; Cat.
शांकर m. a bull, W.
a follower of Śaṃkarācārya, MW.
शांकर n. the Nakṣatra Ārdrā (presided over by Śiva), VarYogay.
सं-कर &c. See सं-√ कॄ.

सं-कर m. mixing together, commingling, intermixture, confusion (esp. of castes or races, proceeding from the intermarriage of a man with a woman of a higher caste or from the promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes, and again from the indiscriminate cohabitation of their descendants; cf. योनि-स्˚), Mn.; MBh. &c.
the offspring of a mixed marriage, R.
any action similar to the intermixture of castes (sometimes n.), MBh.
(in rhet.) the confusion or blending together of metaphors which ought to be kept distinct (opp. to सं-सृष्टि, q.v.), Sāh.; Kpr.
anything that may be defiled by the touch of any unclean thing, MBh.
dung, Car.
dust, sweepings, L.
the crackling of flame, L.
N. of a man, Buddh.
सं-कार See सं-√ कॄ.
सं-कार m. dust, sweepings (-कूट n. a heap of rubbish), Divyāv.
the crackling of flame, L.
शं॑—कृत् (शं॑-), mfn. causing prosperity, beneficent, TĀr.
सं-√ 2. कृत् (only ind.p. -कृत्य and -क॑र्तम्), to cut to pieces, cut through, pierce, ŚBr.
सं-कॄत् See सं-√ कीर्त्.
शंकरी॑ (ई), f. See p. 1055.
शंकरी f. the wife of Śiva, L.
Rubia Munjista, L.
Prosopis Spicigera or Mimosa Suma, ib.
शांकरी (ई), f., see below
शांकरी f. Śiva's arrangement of the letters, the Śivasūtra, Cat.
the commentary of Śaṃkara-miśra, ib.
शांकरि m. patr. of Skanda, Bālar.
of Gaṇeśa, L.
fire, W.
a Muni, ib.
संकरी in comp. for संकर.
सं-कारी f. a girl recently deflowered, new bride, L.
शंकर—कथा f. N. of wk.
शंकर—कवच n. N. of a Kavaca.
शंकर—कवि m. N. of a poet, Cat.
शंकर—किंकर m. a servant or worshipper of Śiva (˚री-भव m. the being or becoming a w˚ of Ś˚), Siṃhās.
N. of an author, Sarvad.
शंकर-किंकरी—भव m., the being or becoming a w˚ of Ś˚
शंकर—क्रोड m. N. of a Nyāya Commentary.
शंकर—गण m. N. of a poet, Subh.
शंकर—गिरि m. N. of a mountain, Daś.
शंकर—गीता f. N. of wk. Hcat.
शंकर—गौरीश m. N. of a temple, Rājat.
शंकर—चरित्र n. N. of wk.,
शंकर—चेतो-विलास m. ‘the play of Śaṃkara's wit’, N. of an artificial poem by Śaṃkara-dīkṣita (celebrating the glories of Vārāṇasī, esp. of its kings Yavanāri and Ceta-siṃha or Chet Singh).
शंकर—जय See संक्षेप॑-शंकर-जय.
शंकर—जित् m. N. of a man, Cat.
शंकर—जी m. N. of an author, ib.
शंकर—जीक m. N. of a scribe, MW.
शंकर—तीर्थ n. N. of ch. of the ŚivaP.
शंकर—दत्त m.
शंकर—दयालु m. N. of authors, Cat.
शंकर—दास m. N. of authors, Cat.
शंकर—दिग्-विजय m. ‘Śaṃkara's victory over every quarter (of the world)’, N. of a fanciful account of the controversial exploits of Śaṃkarācārya (q.v.) by Mādhavācārya (also called संक्षेप-संकरजय)
= शंकर-विजय below
शंकर—दिग्-विजय—डिण्डिम m. N. of wk.
शंकर—दिग्-विजय—सार m. N. of wk.
शंकर—दीक्षित m. N. of a writer of the last century (son of Dīkṣita Bāla-kṛṣṇa; author of the Gaṅgāvatāra-campū-prabandha, Pradyumna-vijaya, and Śaṃkara-ceto-vilāsa).
शंकर—देव m. N. of a form of Śiva, Cat.
of a king and a poet, ib.
शंकर—धर m. N. of a poet, ib.
शंकर—नारायण m. Viṣṇu-Śiva (= हरि-हर), RTL. 65
शंकर—नारायण—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
शंकर—नाराय˚णाष्टोत्तर-शत n. N. of wk.
शंकर—पति m. N. of a man, Buddh.
शंकर—पत्त्र n. N. of wk.
शंकर—पाद-भूषण n. N. of wk.
शंकर—पुष्प m. a white Calotropis, L. (cf. शर्करा-प्˚).
शंकर—प्रादुर्-भाव m. N. of wk.
शंकर—प्रिय m. ‘dear to Śaṃkara’, the Francoline partridge (= तित्तिरि), L.
शंकर—प्रिया f. Śiva's wife, Kathās.
शंकर—बिन्दु m.
शंकर—भट्ट m. N. of authors, Cat.
शंकर—भट्टी f.
शंकर—भट्टीय n. N. of works. (or of one wk.)
शंकर—भारती-तीर्थ m. N. of an author, Cat.
शंकर—भाष्य-न्याय-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
शंकर—मन्दार-सौरभ n. N. of wk.
शंकर—मिश्र m. N. of various authors (esp. of a poet and a philosopher, son of Bhava-nātha; cf. IW. 62, 68), Cat.
शंकर—र्क्ष (for -ऋक्ष), m. N. of the Nakṣatra Ārdrā (presided over by Śiva), L.
शंकर—लाल m. N. of the patron of Kṣemendra (son of Bhū-dhara), Cat.
शंकर—वर्धन m. N. of a man, Rājat.
शंकर—वर्मन् m. N. of a poet, Cat.
शंकर—विजय m. ‘Śaṃkara's victory’, N. of Ānanda-giri's biography of Śaṃkarācārya (recording his controversial victories, as a Vedāntin, over numerous heretics)
of a fanciful life of Śaṃkarācārya (in the form of a dialogue between Cid-vilāsa and Vijñānakanda)
of a poem by Vyāsa-giri (describing the adventures of Śiva)
शंकर—विजय—विलास m. N. of a poem.
शंकर—विलास m. N. of ch. of the SkandaP. and of another wk. by Vidyāraṇya
शंकर—विलास—चम्पू f. N. of a poem by Jagan-nātha.
शंकर—शिक्षा f. N. of wk. on Vedic phonetics.
शंकर—शुक्र n. quicksilver, Bhpr.
शंकर—शुक्ल m. N. of a learned man, Cat.
शंकर—श्वशुर m. ‘Śiva's father-in-law’, N. of the mountain Hima-vat, R.
शंकर—संहिता f.
शंकर—सम्भव m. N. of chs. of the SkandaP.
शंकर—सिद्धि m. N. of a man, Kathās.
शंकर—सेन m. N. of a writer on medicine, Cat.
शंकर—स्तुति f. N. of the 7th Adhyāya of MBh. x.
शंकर—स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra by Bāla-kṛṣṇa.
शंकर—स्वामिन् m. N. of a Brāhman, Kathās.
शंकराख्य N. of two medical works by Rāma and Śaṃkara.
शंकराचार्य See below.

शंकरानन्द m. N. of a philosopher (son of Vāñcheśa and Veṅkaṭāmbā, pupil of Ānandātman and guru of Sāyaṇa; author of the Ātma-purāṇa or Upaniṣad-ratna, containing the substance of a number of Upaniṣads in verse; and of many Commentaries on Upaniṣads and similar works.)
शंकरानन्द—तीर्थ m. N. of author.
शंकरानन्द—नाथ m. N. of author.
शंकराभरण m. (in music) a partic. Rāga, Saṃgīt.
शंकराभ्युदय m. N. of a poem by Rāmakṛṣṇa.
शंकरालय m. ‘Śiva's abode’, the mountain Kailāsa, Cat.
शंकरावास m. id., MW.
a kind of camphor, L.
शंकराष्टक n. N. of wk. by Lakṣmī-nārāyaṇa.
शंकराचार्य—चरित n. N. of wk.
शंकराचार्य—विजय-डिण्डिम n. N. of wk. (cf. शंकर-दिग्विजय-ड्˚)
शंकराचा˚र्यावतार-कथा f. N. of wk.
शंकराचा˚र्योत्पत्ति f. N. of wk.
शंकरी—गीत n. N. of musical wk.
शंकरी—गीति f. N. of musical wk.
शंकरीय mfn. (fr. शंकर) g. उत्करादि
शंकरीय n. N. of wk.
शांकरीय n. N. of wk.
शांकर—ब्राह्मण n. N. of a Brāhmaṇa.
शांकरी—क्रोड m. N. of wk.
शांकरी—रत्नमाला f. N. of wk.
सं-कक्ष See निः-स्˚.
सं-कक्षिका f. a kind of garment, Buddh.
सं-कट mf(आ)n. (prob. Prākṛt for सं-कृत; cf. 2. वि-कट &c.) ‘brought together’, contracted, closed, narrow, strait, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
crowded together, dense, impervious, impassable, MBh.; MārkP.
dangerous, critical, MBh.
(ifc.) crowded with, full of Kād.
सं-कट m. N. of a partic. personification (a son of Kakubh), BhP.
of a man, Rājat.
of a gander or flamingo, Kathās.; Pañcat.; Hit.
सं-कट (अम्), n. a narrow passage, strait, defile, pass, MBh.; Kāv. &c., a strait, difficulty, critical condition, danger to or from (comp.; cf. प्राण-स्˚), ib.
सं-कटा (आ), f., see below
संकटा f. N. of a Yoginī (seven others are named, viz. Maṅgalā, Piṅgalā, Dhanyā, Bhrāmarī, Bhadrikā, Ulkā, Siddhi), Jyot.
of a goddess worshipped in Benares, L.
सं-कट—चतुर्थी f. N. of the fourth day in the dark half of Śrāvaṇa, Cat.
सं-कट—नाशन mfn. removing difficulties, Kām.
सं-कट—मुख mfn. narrow-mouthed, ib.
सं-कट—मुह (for -मुख), ‘id.’, a kind of vessel, Śīl.
सं-कट—स्तोत्र n. N. of a ch. of the Kāśīkhaṇḍa.
सं-कट—स्थ mfn. being in difficulties, Kathās.
सं-कट—हर-चतुर्थी-व्रत n. N. of wk.
संकटाक्ष w.r. for स-क्˚.
संकटापन्न mfn. beset with difficulties, MW.
संकटोत्तीर्ण mfn. released from difficulties, Kathās.
संकटा—नामाष्टक n. N. of a ch. of the Padma-purāṇa.

संकटाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become narrow or too n˚, Kād.;
to become contracted, grow less, ib.
संकटिक mfn. g. कुमुदादि.
संकटिन् mfn. being in danger or difficulties, MārkP.
सं-√ कथ् P. -कथयति, to relate or narrate fully, tell, speak about (acc.), converse, MBh.; BhP.
सं-कथन n. the act of narrating fully, narration, conversation with (instr. with and without सह), MBh.; Naiṣ.
सं-˚कथा f. (ifc. f(आ). ) talk or conversation with (instr. with or without सह) or about (comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
accordance, agreement, Cat.
सं-कथित mfn. related, narrated, communicated, MBh.; R.
सं-√ कन् (only p. -चकान॑), to be pleased or satisfied, RV. v, 30, 17.

सं-√ कम्प् Ā. -कम्पते, to shake about, tremble, quake, MBh.; R. :
Caus. -कम्पयति, to cause to shake or tremble, MBh.
सं-कर्तम् See सम्- √ 2. कृत्.
सं-कर्ष &c. See सं-√ ऋष्.
सं-कर्ष mfn. drawing near, vicinity, neighbourhood, Gobh.
सं-कला ind. killing, slaughter (?), W.
सं-कल m. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 2, 75) collection, accumulation, quantity, W.
addition, ib.
सांकल mfn. (fr. सं-कल) effected or produced by addition, accumulated &c., W.
सं-कालन n. the act of driving (cattle) together (for grazing), Cat.
carrying out or burning (a corpse), R. (v.l. सं-कलन).
सं-˚कलन n. (or f(आ). ) joining or adding or holding together, Kād.
addition, Bījag.
the act of heaping together, W.
सं-˚कलिका-चूर्ण n. shavings, Divyāv.
सं-कलित mfn. heaped together, accumulated &c.
added, Līl.
blended, intermixed, W.
laid hold of, grasped, MW.
सं-कलित n. addition, Līl.
सं-कलिता (आ), f. (in arithm.) the first sum in a progression, Col.
सं-कलि˚तैक्य n. the sum of the sums or terms (of an arithm. progression), Col.
सं-˚कलितिन् mfn. one who has made an addition (with loc.) g. इष्टादि.
सं-कलुष (prob.) n. defilement, impurity (योनि-स्˚, ‘an illegitimate marriage’), MBh. (cf. कलुष-योनि).
सं-कल्प &c. See सं-√ कॢप्.

सं-कल्प॑ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) conception or idea or notion formed in the mind or heart, (esp.) will, volition, desire, purpose, definite intention or determination or decision or wish for (with loc. dat., or ifc.), sentiment, conviction, persuasion
(ibc. often = ‘intentionally’, ‘purposely’, ‘on purpose’, ‘according to will’, &c.; acc. with √ कृ, ‘to form a resolution, make up one's mind’), AV. &c. &c.
idea or expectation of any advantage, W.
a solemn vow or determination to perform any ritual observance, declaration of purpose (e.g. a declaration by a widow of her intention to burn herself with her deceased husband), W.
the Will personified (as a son of Saṃ-kalpā and Brahmā), Hariv.; MārkP.
सं-कल्पा (आ), f. N. of a daughter of Dakṣa (the wife of Dharma and mother of Saṃkalpa), Hariv.
of Manu's wife, Hariv.
सं-कष्ट (prob.) distress, trouble, need (in the following comp.)
सं-कष्ट—चतुर्थी-कथा f. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—चतुर्थी-व्रत-कथा f. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—नाशन-गण-पति-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—नाशन-व्रत n. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—नाशन-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—व्रत n. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—हर-चतुर्थी-व्रत n. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—हर-चतुर्थी-व्रत-काल-निर्णय m. N. of wk.
सं-कष्ट—हरण-स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
सं॑-कसुक mfn. (fr. सम् + √ 1. कस्; often written संकुसुक, or शंकुसुक) splitting, crumbling up (applied to Agni as the destroyer of the body), AV.
(संक॑स्˚), crumbling away, ŚBr.
unsteady, irresolute, MBh. xii, 1044 (accord. to L. also = दुर्बल, मन्द, संकीर्ण, अपवाद-शील, दुर्जन and संश्लेषक)
सं॑-कसुक m. N. of the author of RV. x, 18 (having the patr. यामायन), Anukr.
सं॑का f. (prob. connected with √ सञ्ज्) contest, strife, fight, RV.; TBr.
संकायिका See स-कायिका, p. 1124, col. 1.

सं-√ काश् Ā. -काशते, to appear together, appear in sight, become visible, R. :
Caus. -काशयति, to look at, see, behold, AV.
सं॑-काश m. (ifc. f(आ). ) look, appearance (often ifc. = ‘having the appearance of’, ‘looking like’, ‘resembling’), AV. &c. &c.
vicinity, neighbourhood (w.r. for स-क्˚), L.
सं-˚काश्य w.r. for सां-काश्य.
सांकाश्य m. (fr. सं-काश) N. of a man, MBh.
सांकाश्य n. and f(आ). N. of the town of Kuśa-dhvaja (brother of Janaka), R.
सं-किल m. (said to be fr. शम् + √ किल्) a burning torch, fire-brand, L.
संकील m. N. of a man (v.l. संकीर्ण), Cat.
सं-कीर्ण &c. See सं-√ कॄ.
सं-कीर्ण mfn. poured together, mixed, commingled &c.
crowded with, full of (comp.), MBh.
joined or combined with (comp.), Yājñ., Sch.
mingled, confused, disordered, adulterated, polluted, impure, Mn.; MBh. &c.
born of a mixed marriage, MBh.
mixed, miscellaneous, of various kinds, manifold, Bhar.; Daśar.
sprinkled (esp. with fluid-exudation, as a rutting elephant; but cf. -नाग), L.
contracted, narrow, W.
scattered, strewed, spread, diffused, ib.
सं-कीर्ण m. a man of mixed caste, Bhar.
(in music) a mixed note or mode
N. of an ancient sage (v.l. सं-कील), L.
सं-कीर्ण (अम्), n. confusion (in वाक्य-स्˚, q.v.)
सं-कीर्णा (आ), f. a kind of riddle (of a mixed character), Kāvyād. iii, 105
सं-√ कीर्त् P. -कीर्तयति, to mention or relate fully, announce, proclaim, celebrate, praise, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-कीर्तन n. the act of mentioning fully &c.
praise, celebration, glorification, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-˚कीर्ति m. N. of a Vaiśya (said to have been the author of partic. Vedic hymns), MW.
सं-˚कीर्तित mfn. mentioned fully, celebrated, praised, ib.
सं-कुचन m. ‘Shriveller’, N. of a demon causing disease (v.l. सं-कुटन), Hariv.
सं-कुचन n. contraction, shrinking, shrivelling, Car.
सं-कुचित mfn. contracted, shrunk, shrivelled, narrowed, closed, shut, R.; Bhartṛ.; Suśr.
crouching, cowering, MW.
N. of a place g. तक्षशिलादि.
सांकुचित mfn. derived from Saṃ-kucita g. तक्षशिलादि.
सं-कुञ्चित mfn. curved, bent, Divyāv.
सं-कोच m. contraction, shrinking together, compression, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
shutting up, closing (of the eyes), Sāh.
crouching down, cowering, humbling one's self, shyness, fear (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to become shy or modest’), Hariv.
abridgment, diminution, limitation, restriction, Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
drying up (of a lake), Kāv.
binding, tying, L.
a sort of skate fish, L.
N. of an Asura, MBh.
सं-कोच n. saffron, L.
सं-कोच &c. See सं-√ कुच्.
सं-कोच—कारिन् mfn. making contraction, crouching down, humble, modest, Rājat.
सं-कोच—पत्त्रक mfn. causing the withering of leaves (said of a partic. disease affecting trees), Hariv.
सं-कोच—पिशुन n. saffron, L.
सं-कोच—रेखा f. ‘line of contraction’, a wrinkle, fold, L.
सं-˚कोचक mfn. contracting, causing to shrink or shrivel up, Kāvyād., Sch.
सं-˚कोचन mf(ई)n. (see गात्र-संकोचनी) id.
astringent, MW.
सं-˚कोचन m. N. of a mountain, R.
सं-˚कोचन n. the act of contracting or closing or astringing, MBh.; Suśr.; Sāh.
सं-˚कोचनी f. the sensitive plant (Mimosa Pudica), L.
सं-˚कोचनीय mfn. to be limited or restricted (-त्व n.), Nyāyam., Sch.
सं-˚कोचनीय—त्व n.
सं-˚कोचित n. (fr. Caus.) ‘contraction of the limbs’, a partic. manner of fighting, Hariv.
सं-˚कोचिन् mfn. closing (as a flower), Rājat.
contracting (see गात्र-संक्˚)
diminishing, lessening, Vcar.
astringent, MW.
सं-कुपित mfn. enraged, aroused, excited, MBh.
